We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is the one at hand, maybe the system has a current compound context. We need to get carbon NMR spectra? But aromatic carbons count can be deduced from structure. However we don't have SMILES. Maybe we can retrieve carbon shifts to infer aromatic carbons? Not reliable.

Maybe the environment has a default sample. Could use carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get spectra, then identify aromatic carbon peaks (around 120-150 ppm). But we need count. Could also use retrieve_carbon_shifts to get ranges, but not count.

Better to request carbon_nmr_spectra then analyze peaks. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
